description: Rago catalog seed for Rally AutoGTM (vcglass, ex-VCPeer cold email / GTM automation). Meters outbound cold emails, AI-generated drafts, and credited card top-ups. Two plans: `gtm_usage` (the plan vcglass subscribes a project to by default, RAGO_GTM_PLAN_CODE; $0 metering mirror, because customers are charged through the local Creem balance) and `autogtm_growth` (flat monthly seat plus metered usage, for tenants billed by Rago directly). Also mirrors Relay LLM spend (`relay_llm_usage`) at $0; the Relay route for the Rally gateway key points at this org. Rally plan lifecycle and seat counts mirror into `rally_plan_event` and `rally_seats` on the $0 `rally_plan_mirror` plan (one mirror subscription per Rally account).

billable_metrics.name: GTM Emails Sent
billable_metrics.description: One event per cold/outbound email actually handed to the sending transport (Postal). Counted, not summed.

billable_metrics.name: GTM AI Drafts
billable_metrics.description: One event per AI-generated email/sequence draft produced by the decisions engine. Counted regardless of whether the draft is later sent.

billable_metrics.name: GTM Card Top-ups
billable_metrics.description: One event per card top-up credited to a project's local balance (vcglass lib/autogtm/rago-billing.ts meterRagoTopup, sent only when RAGO_GTM_TOPUP_METERING=1). Sums `properties.amount_cents`. Audit metric: the customer already paid through Creem, so every plan charges it at $0.

billable_metrics.name: Relay LLM Spend
billable_metrics.description: One event per LLM inference routed through Railyard Relay (Relay cost feed, RELAY_COST_FEED_FORMAT=rago; transaction_id = Relay event id). Sums `properties.charged_micros` (retail spend in micro-USD). Properties also carry model, route, input/output/total tokens, charged_usd and settlement.

billable_metrics.name: Rally Plan Events
billable_metrics.description: One event per Rally plan transition (activated, renewed, updated, past_due, cancelled, expired) for founder plans (Creem) and VC tiers, sent by vcglass lib/railyard/plan-mirror.ts when RAGO_URL + RAGO_API_KEY are set. Counted. Properties carry plan, state, provider, account_kind and, when known, amount_cents, billing_cycle and seat_limit. Audit metric: the payment rail already charged the customer.

billable_metrics.name: Rally Seats
billable_metrics.description: One event per Rally seat change (VC team seats, agency client-viewer seats) carrying `properties.seats` = seats in use after the change. max_agg, so a period reports its peak seat count.

plans.name: AutoGTM Usage
plans.description: Default plan vcglass subscribes each project to. $0 base and $0 charges: Rago mirrors usage (emails, drafts, top-ups) for the billing page and allowance checks; the money moves through the project's Creem-funded balance.

plans.name: AutoGTM Growth
plans.description: Flat monthly platform fee plus metered email volume and AI draft generation.

plans.name: Rally Plan Mirror
plans.description: Mirror subscription vcglass creates once per Rally account (user, VC firm, agency) with external id rally-mirror-<kind>-<id> (RAGO_RALLY_PLAN_CODE). $0 base and $0 charges: plan lifecycle and seat counts are visible in Rago while Creem and the VC checkout stay the payment rails.

sample_events.note: POST /events { event: { transaction_id, external_subscription_id, code: 'gtm_email_sent' } } — one per send.
POST /events { event: { transaction_id, external_subscription_id, code: 'gtm_draft' } } — one per generated draft.

POST /events { event: { transaction_id: 'topup:<chargeId>', external_subscription_id, code: 'gtm_topup', properties: { amount_cents } } } — one per credited top-up (opt-in via RAGO_GTM_TOPUP_METERING=1).

Sent by Relay, not vcglass: POST /events { event: { transaction_id: <relay event id>, external_subscription_id: <RELAY_RAGO_ROUTES_JSON subscription_id>, code: 'relay_llm_usage', properties: { charged_micros, total_tokens, model, ... } } }.
